project_description.summary: Design-Build project to demolish an existing Halon 1301 fire suppression system in the basement server room (Room 003) of Building D323 (Farragut Hall) at Naval Support Facility Indian Head, Maryland, and replace it with a modern clean agent fire detection and suppression system. The project also includes exhaust system upgrades (addressed in separate BOD) to allow fire services safe reentry after agent discharge. Building D323 is a 32,645 SF historic 1941 structure serving as the Naval Operations Center / Information Services facility for NSWC Indian Head.

scope_details.fire_suppression: New clean agent suppression system (inert gas, e.g., nitrogen or Novec 1230 per calculations) protecting below the raised floor in Room 003. Pre-engineered NFPA 2001 compliant system replacing halon cylinders (Kidde KPH-60, DOT stamp 1982) and obsolete control panel (Fire Lite Sensiscan 1000).
scope_details.fire_detection: New Fire Alarm Releasing Control Panel with Very Early Warning Smoke Detection (VEWSD) under raised floor; above-floor smoke detectors; EPO switch supervision; relay interface with CRAC units; connection to main building FACP (System 3, 1st floor lobby); radio transmitter to Emergency Operations Center in Building D327 via AES radio mesh network.
scope_details.exhaust_system: New inline exhaust fans, exhaust ductwork, intake/exhaust air louvers with motorized dampers, underfloor grilles (per MECHANICAL and Electrical BOD).
scope_details.demolition: Remove existing halon suppression piping, cylinders, detectors, and control panel. Halon cylinders to be turned in to DLA Distribution Richmond per DoD ODS procedures.
scope_details.hazmat_context: ACM present in building (floor tile mastic, pipe insulation); LBP present on concrete surfaces. Disturbance to be minimized; sampling/abatement plans required if ACM disturbed during installation of conduit straps or penetrations.
scope_details.room_integrity: Fan pressurization leak test per NFPA 2001 required. Pressure relief vent to be installed on wall between Corridor H002 and Vestibule V002.
scope_details.calculations: Nitrogen conceptual design by Jemmel A. Pursoo, PE (5/23/2025): ~39 total cylinders for combined under-floor and above-floor protection at 30% design concentration. Pressure relief calculation (4/30/2025): 0.06 atm / 136 psf differential. Hold time test (Harris Fire, 5/13/2025): 12.13 minutes at 7-ft minimum height for Novec 1230 at 4.5% concentration.

drawings.notes: No drawing set PDFs present in intake directory. Floor plans are embedded as image fragments in the SOW PDF appendix but are not a structured drawing set. The embedded floor plan shows basement layout with room areas labeled; Room 003 (server room) raised floor outlined in red showing the area to be protected by clean agent system (approximately 1,817 SF). These are reference floor plans included as SOW attachments, not BFA-produced design drawings.

conflict_flags.rationale: 3838 Strauss Avenue appears in multiple sources including the halon inspection report header and the preliminary enclosure integrity test (Harris Fire, 2025). The 3817 address in the Leidos report is likely a transcription error. Both sources refer to Building D323 without ambiguity.
